audience: people who plan their tasks, habits and meetings with Reclaim.ai

useCases.title: List your tasks with due dates and time needed
useCases.text: The AI lists your tasks and opens one by id, so you get an overview of what is due and how much time each task needs.

useCases.title: Look at your calendar for a time window
useCases.text: The AI lists your calendar events in an optional start and end window, so you can see how busy tomorrow or this week is.

useCases.title: Review your daily habits
useCases.text: The AI lists your daily habits and opens one to show how it is set up.

useCases.title: Add a task or change an existing one
useCases.text: The AI creates a new task, which Reclaim schedules into your calendar automatically, or changes fields of an existing task. Only the fields you give are changed.

useCases.title: Add time or log work on a task, then complete or reopen it
useCases.text: The AI adds scheduled time to a task, logs work you did, and marks a task complete or reopens it.
